name: io.github.CSOAI-ORG/clinical-trials-ai-mcp
summary: Fixed reference-data trial-tool demonstration; not a clinical-trial registry evidence source.
runtime: Not independently runtime tested by registry
capabilities: Search, compare and display hardcoded demonstration trial records
limitation: Trial tools use a simulated TRIALS_DB rather than live registry retrieval. NCT-formatted identifiers and current timestamps do not establish source provenance or currency. Randomization inferred from arm count is unsupported.
history: Previously published; approval superseded on September 7, 2026. Original ID and inclusion date retained.
